description.narrative:
Stöd till EarthRights International är en USA-baserad organisation som arbetar i Mekongregionen. Målen för det regionala programmet är att stärka människors möjligheter att delta i och påverka lokala beslut, öka kunskapen om mänskliga rättigheter och miljörättigheter, möjliggöra krav på ersättning vid överträdelser från företag och myndigheter samt stärka lagstiftning, policyramverk och skyddet för människorättsförsvarare.
EarthRights verkar för att stärka människors rättigheter, med fokus på miljö- och klimaträttigheter. Verksamheten har även mål relaterat till jämställdhet.

Support to EarthRights International, a US based organisation, that operated in the Mekong region. The objectives of the regional programme is to strengthen people's ability to participate in and influence local decision-making, increase awareness of human rights and environmental rights, enable demands for compensation in cases of violations by companies and authorities, and reinforce legislation, policy frameworks, and protection for human rights defenders.
EarthRights’ core mission is to strengthen human rights, with a focus on environmental and climate-related issues. The operations also pursue goals related to gender equality.

The Mekong programme follows ERIs strategic plan 2025-2029, and aims to contribute to the following regional goals:
1. Community Empowerment for Meaningful Leadership, Influence, and Inclusion Frontline and Indigenous communities increasingly drive, influence, and meaningfully participate in development project decision-making that affects their land, environment, and community.
2. Increased Accountability and Access to Remedy States, corporations, and international finance institutions are pressured to implement practices that respect human and environmental rights and prevent climate abuses, and communities have improved access to remedies when violations occur.
3. Legal Frameworks for Environmental and Human Rights Protection Strengthen laws, standards, and policies for the protection of the environmental and human rights of frontline and Indigenous communities and environmental and human rights defenders in the Mekong region.
4. Environmental and Human Rights Defenders Safety, Security, and Well-Being Environmental and human rights defenders in the region are able to operate safely and securely as they work to prevent, reduce, and obtain remedy for environmental harms and rights abuses.
